label: Shopping
tooltip: Auto-buy from the Expedition Antiquarian when silver or gold hits a threshold. Never starts during a FATE or CE.

enable_auto_shop.label: Enable auto-shop
enable_auto_shop.tooltip:
On: when silver or gold is at its threshold (and you are not in a FATE or CE), pause other automation, go to camp, and buy from your shopping list. Can interrupt treasure hunting and idle Mob Farmer waits; not mid-pull or mid-fight.
Off: never auto-shop.

silver_threshold.label: Silver threshold
silver_threshold.tooltip: Start shopping when silver pieces (South Horn) or silver obols (North Horn) reach this. Never during a FATE or CE, or mid Mob Farmer pull/fight. 0 = never start from silver.

gold_threshold.label: Gold threshold
gold_threshold.tooltip: Start shopping when gold pieces (South Horn) or gold obols (North Horn) reach this. Never during a FATE or CE, or mid Mob Farmer pull/fight. 0 = never start from gold.

reserve_silver.label: Keep at least (silver)
reserve_silver.tooltip: Do not spend silver below this amount.

reserve_gold.label: Keep at least (gold)
reserve_gold.tooltip: Do not spend gold below this amount.

shopping_order.label: Shopping list
shopping_order.tooltip: Keep stock, Buy a set count, or Keep Buying as a currency sink. Empty = do not auto-shop.
shopping_order.when_ready_hint: Shop when silver or gold reaches its threshold (not during a FATE/CE, or mid Mob Farmer pull/fight). Keep at least leaves a reserve unspent.
shopping_order.zone_any: Currency type follows the Occult Crescent zone you are in.
shopping_order.empty: No items — add from the catalog.
shopping_order.col_keep_hint: Restock until your inventory has this many (every shopping trip).
shopping_order.col_buy_hint: Buy this many more times, then stop (counts down after each purchase).
shopping_order.col_keep_buying_hint: After Keep and Buy are done, spend leftover currency on this item. Only one Sink on the list.
shopping_order.modes_help:
Keep: restock until you have this many.
Buy: buy this many times, then stop.
Sink: after Keep/Buy, keep spending on this one item (only one Sink allowed).
shopping_order.currency_pick_hint: This item can be bought with more than one currency. Check which ones auto-shop may use. If several are checked, it picks one you can afford.
